note: A fund row describes one held fund.
An investment row describes one security or direct investment.
A program-related investment row describes one reported investment.
A portfolio row is an aggregate and not one investee position.
An asset-class row is an aggregate and not one investee position.
The printed row does not identify one investee position.
An unrecognized subject remains source evidence and is not published as a position.
A blank scope does not override an admitted investee subject.
The value describes one fund position.
A portfolio total remains evidence and is not an additional position.
A statement or hierarchy summary remains evidence and is not an additional position.
An unrecognized value scope remains evidence until its position grain is reviewed.
